mapper.sql: provider, provider_place_id, name, name_normalized, address, latitude, longitude, categories, phone, website, country_code, picked_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_place_cache (provider, provider_place_id, name, name_normalized, address, latitude, longitude, categories, phone, website, country_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{entry.provider}, #{entry.providerPlaceId}, #{entry.name}, #{entry.nameNormalized}, #{entry.address}, #{entry.latitude}, #{entry.longitude}, #{entry.categories}, #{entry.phone}, #{entry.website}, #{entry.countryCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_place_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, name_normalized = EXCLUDED.name_normalized, address = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.address, map_place_cache.address), latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, categories = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.categories, map_place_cache.categories), phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, map_place_cache.phone), website = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.website, map_place_cache.website), country_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.country_code, map_place_cache.country_code), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE map_place_cache SET picked_count = picked_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_place_id = #{providerPlaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT body FROM map_response_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey} AND expires_at > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_response_cache (cache_key, operation, provider, body, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{operation}, #{provider}, #{body}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET operation = EXCLUDED.operation, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, body = EXCLUDED.body, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT leg_key, provider, profile, from_lat, from_lng, to_lat, to_lng, distance_m, duration_s, polyline FROM route_leg_cache WHERE leg_key IN #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_leg_cache (leg_key, provider, profile, from_lat, from_lng, to_lat, to_lng, distance_m, duration_s, polyline, created_at, last_used_at) VALUES (#{entry.legKey}, #{entry.provider}, #{entry.profile}, #{entry.fromLat}, #{entry.fromLng}, #{entry.toLat}, #{entry.toLng}, #{entry.distanceM}, #{entry.durationS}, #{entry.polyline}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (leg_key) DO UPDATE SET provider = EXCLUDED.provider, distance_m = EXCLUDED.distance_m, duration_s = EXCLUDED.duration_s, polyline = EXCLUDED.polyline, last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
